question.text: Spread margin benefit for calendar spreads is available for contracts among the:

answer.text: First six expiring contracts of the same commodity

explanation.text: The Logic: Spread margin is permitted when each individual contract in the spread is among the first six expiring contracts. The Trap: The rule is not 'any contract', 'nearest two months', or 'within one year' — it is specifically the first six expiring contracts. Note: The source states the first-six-contract rule but does not give a rationale; do not attach an unsourced liquidity or beyond-six-month explanation.
